next_step: Closed-lost: decided to self-host (vLLM + TGI + TensorRT-LLM). Watch for infra budget reset in Q4.
notes:
Summary:
- Closed-lost (internal decision to self-host). Primary reason: control + lower long-term cost for high-volume embeddings and reranking workloads.
- Tech decision: infra team chose vLLM + TGI + TensorRT-LLM stack on bare-metal A100 fleet (quantized int8 pipeline).

CRM timeline (short bullets):
- 2024-08-20: initial inbound (product demo) — AE Jordan intro call. Interested in replacing aging embedding service.
- 2024-09-02: discovery with engineering (Maya P. SE) — throughput targets 2k qps for embeddings, <40ms p95 for short chat flows.
- 2024-10-07: Demo (hosted API + dedicated latency breakdown). Shared cost model vs. self-host.
- 2024-11-12: Security questionnaire delivered; asked for SOC2, KMS integrations, audit log retention policy. (see drive doc).
- 2024-12-10: Fireflies call — PO and infra present. CTO quote: "We can't hand over key material or prefix cache behavior to a vendor right now."
- 2025-01-15: Sec review deep dive (ff-20250115-sec-review). Security asked for HSM-backed KMS and on-prem runtime option.
- 2025-02-05: Pricing review + procurement sync. Procurement signaled budget cap and preference for capital expenditure if self-host.
- 2025-02-18: Final decision — team announced self-host route, vendor closed-lost.

Key signals / requirements captured:
- Workloads: embeddings + reranking first, chat assistant (internal) later. Heavy embeddings volume drives econ.
- Targets: embeddings throughput 1500-2500 qps, reranking <100ms p95 for top-10, chat latency <40ms p95 for 256-token.
- Must-haves per security: on-prem control of keys (HSM), audit logs retained 7+ years, SSO/SAML, data residency in NA.
- Ops constraint: infra will manage quantization, KV-cache eviction policies; cannot rely on opaque vendor cache.

Why they chose self-host (notes from execs):
- Predictable unit economics at scale: their forecasts show break-even within 9–12 months for embeddings heavy workloads.
- Control: need to instrument KV cache + custom batching for latency-sensitive paths.
- Security: legal requires customer-controlled KMS/HSM and full network isolation for certain datasets.

Remaining opportunities / follow-up plan:
- Not a permanent loss — watch for 6–12 month infra pain points (ops load, model upgrades, quantization regressions).
- Proposed outreach: offer a short troubleshooting engagement if they hit accuracy regressions after quantization.
- Marketing touch: send case study on hybrid deployments and Optimize tooling that reduces self-host ops burden.

Stubs / refs:
- Pricing deck (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Vd-verdigris-poc-pricing
- Security FAQ (drive): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1S3-security-faq
- Fireflies: ff-20241210-verdigris-demo, ff-20250115-sec-review
- Jira tickets opened during POC: INFRA-472 (throughput tests), SEC-291 (KMS questions)

Notes tone: choppy CRM fragments, direct quotes included. Follow-up owner: AE to monitor for infra distress signals; SE available for technical consultations.
